description: This file defines the BasicCycler class, which simulates a battery cycler for testing and programming cells with functions for constant current (CC) and constant voltage (CV) cycling, including data storage and retrieval, and various cycling methods.

classes.name: slide::BasicCycler
classes.description: A class that simulates a basic battery cycler capable of performing CC and CV cycling, storing cycling data, and managing cell states.

methods.name: storeResults
methods.description: Stores cycling data of a cell at each step.

methods.name: setCurrent
methods.description: Auxiliary function to set the current during cycling.

methods.name: findCVcurrent_recursive
methods.description: Recursively finds the current to maintain a constant voltage.

methods.name: findCVcurrent_recursive_bin
methods.description: Binary search version to find the current for constant voltage.

methods.name: getCell
methods.description: Returns a reference to the cell being cycled.

methods.name: setCyclingDataTimeResolution
methods.description: Changes the data collection time resolution.

methods.name: clearData
methods.description: Clears recorded cycling data.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the cycler state.

methods.name: openFolder
methods.description: Opens or creates a folder for data storage based on data interval.

methods.name: writeCyclingData
methods.description: Writes cycling data to a CSV file with a standard name.

methods.name: writeCyclingData
methods.description: Writes cycling data to a specified CSV file.

methods.name: returnCyclingData
methods.description: Returns cycling data vectors instead of writing to file.

methods.name: CC_t_V
methods.description: Performs a CC cycle with specified current, duration, and voltage limits.

methods.name: CC_t
methods.description: Performs a CC cycle for a fixed time.

methods.name: CC_V
methods.description: Performs a CC cycle until a voltage is reached.

methods.name: CC_halfCell_full
methods.description: Performs a CC cycle on a single electrode.

methods.name: findCVcurrent
methods.description: Finds the current needed to maintain a constant voltage.

methods.name: findCVcurrent_bin
methods.description: Binary search version for constant voltage current.

methods.name: CV_t_I
methods.description: Performs a CV cycle with time and current limits.

methods.name: CV_t
methods.description: Performs a CV cycle for a fixed time.

methods.name: CV_I
methods.description: Performs a CV cycle until current drops below a threshold.

methods.name: CC_t_CV_t
methods.description: Performs a hybrid CC-CV cycle for a given time.

methods.name: CC_V_CV_I
methods.description: Loads the cell to a specified voltage with a CC phase followed by CV.

methods.name: followI
methods.description: Follows a predefined current pattern from CSV.

methods.name: followI
methods.description: Follows a predefined current pattern from vectors.
